title: MKS to Showcase Surface Finishing, Laser and Process Analytics Solutions at The Battery Show India 2026
body_markdown:
16. Oct 2026 | Tradeshows and events


# MKS to Showcase Surface Finishing, Laser and Process Analytics Solutions at The Battery Show India 2026


**Berlin, October 16, 2026 –** MKS Inc. (NASDAQ: MKSI), a global provider of enabling technologies that transform our world, will exhibit at The Battery Show India 2026, taking place from October 2-4, 2026, at the India Expo Centre, Greater Noida, India.


As India’s battery and electric mobility industries continue to expand, The Battery Show India brings together manufacturers, technology providers, and industry experts to explore innovations shaping the future of energy storage and electrification.


At booth **7.51 in Hall 7** , MKS will showcase a comprehensive portfolio of solutions designed to support the development and manufacture of next-generation batteries. Drawing on expertise in surface finishing, photonics, and process monitoring, MKS technologies help improve product performance, manufacturing efficiency, and process reliability across battery production.


The company’s solutions address key battery manufacturing challenges, including corrosion protection, adhesion enhancement, and electrical performance optimization for applications ranging from current collector foils, battery terminals, connectors, and busbars to battery modules, packs, and thermal management system components. Complementing its surface finishing portfolio, MKS will highlight advanced laser and process analytics technologies that enable greater precision, process control, and production efficiency throughout battery manufacturing operations.


In addition to exhibiting at the show, MKS will participate in the conference program with a presentation titled “Corrosion management in and around Li-Ion batteries,” presented by Arshali Sasi, Associate Manager, R&D Energy at MKS’ Atotech.


**This year’s highlights are:**


**Interlox®** ‒ Zirconium-based conversion coatings and passivates for enhanced paint and adhesive bonding, offering peak corrosion performance and optimized operating cost.


**Covertron® 600** – Cr-free pretreatment for plastic metallization suitable for the ABS, ABS/PC, and 2K/3K/ selective materials that are currently produced with Cr(VI)-based processes.


**UniPrep®** ‒ Long life, low temperature cleaning solutions, achieving superior cleaning performance with optimized operating cost and reduced energy demand.


**Nichem® MP 1188** ‒ Mid-phosphorus electroless nickel solution, providing non-magnetic, highly corrosion resistant, and pit-free deposits for battery terminals and ensuring superior chemical and corrosion resistance.


**Cupracid® Up** ‒ Advanced copper plating solution, used as an intermediate layer between nickel strike or immersion copper layer and the top electromagnetic shielding nickel iron layer.


**CuProtect® XL** ‒ Cr(VI)-free post-treatment, operating at high speed in high current densities with short exposition times.


**Silvertech® C** ‒ Silver carbon deposit for switches and connectors.


**Spectra-Physics® Lasers** – High-performance laser solutions supporting precision materials processing applications, including battery manufacturing processes that require exceptional accuracy, throughput, and process consistency.


**MultiGas™ FTIR Gas Analyzer** – Advanced real-time gas analysis technology enabling process monitoring and control across critical manufacturing environments.


Attendees are invited to join the presentation and visit the MKS booth to learn more about the company’s technologies for battery manufacturing.


Presentation


**Corrosion Management in and around Li-Ion batteries**
